name: Bana bird noodle soup
summary: Go Vietnam’s Măng Đen article describes bánh canh cooked with the meat of a forest bird, now a farmed bird, and le bamboo shoots. The flavour it prints is a clean sweetness.
origin: Go Vietnam places bánh canh chim in the Măng Đen food section and calls the style Bana.
taste: Go Vietnam prints a clean sweet flavour from the bird and le bamboo shoots.
howToEat: A bowl of bánh canh with bird meat and măng le. The article prints 35,000–55,000 VND a bowl. A street and a clock were not printed. Check on arrival.
where: Măng Đen, in that food section. It does not say the bowl is on a Kon Tum city street. Check on arrival.
priceBand: Go Vietnam’s Măng Đen article prints 35,000–55,000 VND a bowl.
